description: This file defines the AWS KinesisVideoArchivedMediaClient class, which is used to interact with the Amazon Kinesis Video Streams Archived Media service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as retrieving clips, streaming URLs, images, media fragments, and listing fragments.

classes.name: KinesisVideoArchivedMediaClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Kinesis Video Streams Archived Media service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: getClip
methods.description: Retrieves a media clip from the archived media storage based on provided arguments.

methods.name: getDASHStreamingSessionURL
methods.description: Gets a URL for DASH streaming session.

methods.name: getHLSStreamingSessionURL
methods.description: Gets a URL for HLS streaming session.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves images related to the video media.

methods.name: getMediaForFragmentList
methods.description: Retrieves media fragments specified in the fragment list.
